text:
Tariq: Heads-up — demo of the Electron quickstart just failed awkwardly. WS opened, we got a couple of tokens, then the connection closed with a 402 mid-session. Token was valid and the same flow works for my personal account.
Lina: ouch. did you capture the ws frames or any headers?
Tariq: i grabbed a pcap and the frame stream includes a JSON control frame: {"error":{"code":"billing_required","message":"attach a payment method to continue streaming"}} after some normal chunks. WS close code looks like 4006.
onboard-bot: Notice: workspace "acme-desktop" trial expired. Streaming/websocket sessions are restricted until billing is added. https://app.redwood.ai/orgs/acme-desktop/billing
Tariq: interestingly the desktop SDK did not do a billing preflight like the web quickstart does. maybe parity gap between SDKs.
sdk-qa: confirmed — desktop/electron client uses the low-level ws stream manager and historically we didn't run org metadata checks there. JS/browser and python quickstarts already added a preflight check last quarter.
mika: that explains it. UX is really bad because apps show partial content then die. Short-term: demo with a non-streaming call or include a preflight GET /v1/orgs/me/billing_status before opening WS. Also, don't retry on 402 — it confuses users.
Tariq: can we surface a nicer error in the SDK so the app shows a single error dialog instead of partial text?
Lina: yes — filing ticket RD-4502 to add a billing_precheck option to the stream manager and to ensure the SDK emits an "error" event before emitting any content when the precheck fails.
ops-bot: Ops note: check headers `x-rw-trial-state` and `x-rw-reason` on the initial handshake. Some edge proxies emit a 200 handshake then inject a control billing frame; we'll try to make the control explicit at accept time.
sdk-qa: parity note — we'll add the same preflight to electron and the native desktop SDKs. Also updating the sample electron README to recommend `stream=false` for demos if billing not configured.
mika: we should also fix error mapping: CLI and SDK should map billing_required -> a clear CLI message and skip retries. I can file the companion bug for rw-cli behavior.
Tariq: posted a tiny repro script (ws client) and pcap in the thread. Minimal repro: `node repro-ws.js --url "wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/chat/stream" --auth "$RW_KEY"` which shows a couple of data frames then {"error":{"code":"billing_required"}}.
Lina: thanks — i'll take the SDK change. @sdk-qa please coordinate on tests so the electron quickstart gets an integration verifying preflight behavior.
sdk-qa: will add a unit + e2e that stubs the billing_status endpoint to return trial_expired and assert the stream client fails fast with a clear error.
mika: docs action: add a short note in the quickstart "If you see partial output followed by a billing error, check your org billing status and prefer non-streaming calls for demos."
Tariq: thanks all. For now switched demo to stream=false and it returned a single 402 which made the failure obvious. Leaving the ws frames and pcap here if anyone wants to triage further.
